name: Pet Dreamland Veterinary Clinic
address: Al Kheeran First - Dubai Creek Harbour - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Pet Dreamland Veterinary Clinic in Dubai Creek Harbour is your one-stop destination for pet care. We offer veterinary consultations, routine check-ups, vaccinations, diagnostics and treatment, along with in-store pet grooming, daycare, cat boarding and pet supplies. Can’t come to us? Our Mobile Veterinary Clinic and Mobile Grooming services bring professional pet care right to your doorstep. Whether your pet needs veterinary care, a fresh groom, a comfortable stay or everyday essentials, our team is here to care for your pets in-clinic or at home.

reviews.author: Amelia Cook
reviews.text:
Jerwyn cut my toy poodle Otto’s fur exactly as I asked and gave him a lovely summer cut. He did a wonderful job, and I am so impressed.

I will definitely keep coming back to this groomer and would recommend them to everyone. Jerwyn and Joshua are both so talented, and we love the whole team at Pet Dreamland, including Alfie, Lyn and Dr Prince. They are always so friendly and professional, and they take such wonderful care of my dogs.

A really talented and caring group of people who are genuine pet lovers.
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback and for trusting us with Otto’s grooming. We’re thrilled to hear that Jerwyn was able to give Otto the perfect summer cut exactly as you envisioned.

Your kind words mean so much to all of us at Pet Dreamland.
We sincerely appreciate your continued support and recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you and Otto and Albie back again soon!

You can really see that the clinic takes the health and well-being of pets seriously. I’m very grateful to the whole team for their care and attention.

I brought Zuzu in for her spay, and I was impressed by how gently Dr. Prince and the team handled everything. They marked her ear neatly and respectfully — not the harsh cut that some places still do — and it really shows their genuine concern for animal welfare.

What stood out the most is their sensitivity to responsible cat population management. They understand the importance of keeping things under control in a humane and balanced way — because we all know what happens when no one steps up. Their contribution is discreet but incredibly valuable, always putting the animal’s dignity first.

I highly recommend Pet Dreamland Veterinary Clinic for their ethics, professionalism, and true compassion. It’s rare to find a team that does things right without turning it into marketing. Thank you for the great care. 🐾❤️
ps: Zuzu available for adoption :)

reviews.author: Carah D' Expat
reviews.text:
I cannot thank Pet Dreamland enough, especially Dr. Esraa, for the exceptional care she gave to my beloved cat, Snowy.

Although I have been a long-time customer of their mobile grooming services, I decided to bring Snowy to their clinic after visiting several other veterinary clinics for her condition and not receiving the results I was hoping for.

We visited three different clinics before coming to Pet Dreamland, but it was only with Dr. Esraa that I truly felt someone genuinely cared about my cat's well-being. Snowy has been suffering from an autoimmune disease for a long time, along with severe inflammation,which I also just found out as the other clinics just always give us a cream and never suggested for any other solution, and it was heartbreaking to watch her struggle every day.

There came a point when I felt hopeless and even considered putting her to sleep because I couldn't bear to see her suffer anymore. But Dr. Esraa gave Snowy a chance when I was ready to give up. Her confidence, compassion, and dedication gave me hope that my cat could still recover.

She took the time to understand Snowy's condition, explained everything clearly, and treated her with so much patience and compassion. Most importantly, she never made us feel like just another case-she genuinely cared about Snowy's recovery and well-being.

Today, Snowy is recovering well, and for the first time in a long while, we are seeing real progress and hope. I am deeply grateful to Dr. Esraa and the entire Pet Dreamland team for their support, commitment, and genuine care.

I hope to share a photo of Snowy soon once she has fully recovered. Thank you for giving my precious cat a second chance and for treating her like family. I will never forget what you have done for us.

Highly recommended!
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you so much for sharing Snowy's journey with us. Your kind words truly mean to our entire team. We're so grateful that you trusted us with Snowy's care, and it means so much to know that we could be part of her recovery. Seeing her make progress is the greatest reward for us. We wish Snowy continued healing and can't wait to see her photo when she's feeling even better. Thank you for letting us be part of her story.
